hypothesis: An exact earlier field value can choose a later field's historical continuation better than the latest same-field donor. Learn mappings only after completed flat template invocations; decoder-visible predictions require no paid donor pointer.
diagnosed_failure: Existing same-route donor and schema-exception receipts do not establish useful conditional dependence. The just-completed FIFO byte-reference representation loses complete BZip2 bytes despite fewer transformed bytes. This explores conditional prediction rather than another word-token or grammar-storage mutation.

scope.validation_and_confirmation: Remain unopened; no native FX2 benefit or corpus inference.

configuration.syntax: Byte-preserving flat {{template|key=value|...}} subset; parser sees only reconstructed prefix. Unknown/malformed/nested syntax falls back without normalization.
configuration.replacement: FIFO insertion; replace existing identical lookup keys deterministically
configuration.lookup: (template, first completed field key, first completed field value, current later key) -> most recently completed target bytes
configuration.learning: Commit relationships only after an invocation closes and passes bounded subset validation. Never retroactively alter earlier predictions on a malformed future suffix.
configuration.base: Uniform raw-byte parent, explicitly a correctness comparator with no competitive compression inheritance.
configuration.specialist: At start of later value, select donor from already completed invocations. Use a deterministic half-prior sequence mixture with the uniform parent; update posterior only after decoded truths. Fixed integer probability rounding. No transmitted dictionary or donor pointers.

arms.K: Same parent probabilities and payload plus exact parser/dictionary bookkeeping.
arms.R: Latest same-field donor with equal parser and capacity budget.
arms.S: Causally rotated completed associations; no future values or corpus-derived choices.

deliverables: One prefix-driven parser and bounded predictor, no full-invocation lookahead.
Reuse existing ArithmeticEncoder/ArithmeticDecoder primitives; exact framed synthetic archives with raw length/hash, archive caps and corruption checks.
Independent reconstruction and repeat, P/K probability and payload identity, rolling probability/state synchronization evidence.
Three-record conditional-versus-recency falsifier plus future-suffix counterfactual, unseen/duplicate keys, truncated/nested syntax, capacity eviction and arbitrary bytes.
Measure complete synthetic archive bytes, actual CPU and peak memory, and exact required local source files. No score or scale authority.
stop_rule: Freeze one configuration on synthetic fixtures. A counterfactual causality, inverse, repeat, synchronization or bound failure is an implementation failure and must remain visible. Synthetic gains do not authorize corpus or native-parent launch. Any native integration requires separate source, population, control and resource bindings.
